policy.legacy_capture_status: The two repository-pinned faithful webpage text captures predate the local-database-to-Drive webpage default and remain valid immutable legacy capture material for this already-started lifecycle. Their former source-pack.zip binary wrapper was found structurally corrupt at runtime and has been retired from the live tree; Git history preserves the failed wrapper for audit, but it is not Evidence and is not an execution input.
policy.tool_limit_rule: A missing preferred acquisition mechanism may change capture representation but must never justify skipping readable source information.
policy.evidence_boundary: Search snippets and discovery summaries are not source captures. A faithful webpage capture must preserve directly read source content, source identity, capture mode, limitations and a digest of the immutable captured representation. Transport never changes source authority.

source_pack.integrity_observation: GitHub Actions run 32627734185 proved both standalone capture SHA-256 pins matched while source-pack.zip did not match its recorded digest. Independent structural inspection of the exact repository bytes showed the ZIP central-directory structure was invalid. The wrapper was therefore retired rather than re-certified with the observed bad digest.
source_pack.retirement_rule: Do not reconstruct or upload a replacement binary wrapper from the interactive Agent. Grounded Evidence consumes the two independently pinned text captures directly. If a future portable webpage-capture bundle is required, use the current bounded local capture DB -> Google Drive handoff path.
